tourist. A person who visits a place for fun.
pack. To put things into a bag for a trip.
alone. With no one else.
interesting. Making you want to know more.
trip. A journey to a place and back again.
together. With other people.
lost. Not knowing where you are or how to get back.
package. A trip where travel, hotel and tours are sold together.
harm. Damage or hurt done to something.
souvenir. Something you buy to remember a place.
